title: 跨层对账：DWD 重算 vs DWS 汇总（笔数 + 金额）
code:
# 跨层对账：DWD 明细重算 vs DWS 汇总（笔数 + 金额双向核对）
# 明细层数据（已清洗到 DWD），口径：pay_status = paid 计入 GMV
DWD_ROWS = [
    ("2026-03-01", "SO01", "paid",   100),
    ("2026-03-01", "SO02", "paid",   250),
    ("2026-03-01", "SO03", "cancel", 300),
    ("2026-03-01", "SO04", "paid",   150),
    ("2026-03-02", "SO05", "paid",   420),
    ("2026-03-02", "SO06", "paid",    80),
    ("2026-03-02", "SO07", "unpaid",  60),
    ("2026-03-02", "SO08", "paid",   200),
]

# 用例 A：DWS 汇总与 DWD 重算完全一致
DWS_A = {"2026-03-01": (3, 500), "2026-03-02": (3, 700)}
# 用例 B：DWS 在 03-02 漏了 SO08（例如时区切分把跨天订单漏了）
DWS_B = {"2026-03-01": (3, 500), "2026-03-02": (2, 480)}


def rollup_from_dwd(rows):
    agg = {}
    for dt, oid, status, amt in rows:
        if status != "paid":
            continue
        c, a = agg.get(dt, (0, 0))
        agg[dt] = (c + 1, a + amt)
    return agg


def reconcile(dwd_agg, dws):
    diffs = []
    for dt in sorted(set(list(dwd_agg.keys()) + list(dws.keys()))):
        dc, da = dwd_agg.get(dt, (0, 0))
        wc, wa = dws.get(dt, (0, 0))
        diffs.append((dt, dc, wc, dc - wc, da, wa, da - wa))
    return diffs


def report(tag, dws, expect_clean):
    dwd_agg = rollup_from_dwd(DWD_ROWS)
    rows = reconcile(dwd_agg, dws)
    print("== 用例 " + tag + "：" + ("对账一致（期望差额全为 0）" if expect_clean
                                  else "对账不一致（期望检出差额）") + " ==")
    print("  分区         DWD笔数 DWS笔数 Δ笔数 | DWD金额 DWS金额 Δ金额 | 一致")
    total_cnt_diff = 0
    total_amt_diff = 0
    for dt, dc, wc, difc, da, wa, difa in rows:
        same = (difc == 0 and difa == 0)
        total_cnt_diff += abs(difc)
        total_amt_diff += abs(difa)
        print("  " + dt + "   " + str(dc).rjust(6) + str(wc).rjust(7) +
              str(difc).rjust(6) + " |" + str(da).rjust(8) + str(wa).rjust(8) +
              str(difa).rjust(7) + " | " + str(same))
    clean = (total_cnt_diff == 0 and total_amt_diff == 0)
    print("  合计 |Δ笔数| = " + str(total_cnt_diff) + "，合计 |Δ金额| = " + str(total_amt_diff))
    print("  对账结论 = " + ("一致" if clean else "不一致"))
    print("  是否符合预期 = " + str(clean == expect_clean))
    return total_cnt_diff, total_amt_diff


ca = report("A", DWS_A, True)
print("")
cb = report("B", DWS_B, False)

print("")
print("判据 1（一致的跨层对账：笔数与金额差额均为 0）: " + str(ca[0] == 0 and ca[1] == 0))
print("判据 2（漏数据的 DWS 被对账检出：金额差额 != 0）: " + str(cb[1] != 0))
print("判据 3（差额可被定位到具体分区：03-02 少 1 笔、少 220 元）: " +
      str(cb[0] == 1 and cb[1] == 220))
expected_output:
== 用例 A：对账一致（期望差额全为 0） ==
  分区         DWD笔数 DWS笔数 Δ笔数 | DWD金额 DWS金额 Δ金额 | 一致
  2026-03-01        3      3     0 |     500     500      0 | True
  2026-03-02        3      3     0 |     700     700      0 | True
  合计 |Δ笔数| = 0，合计 |Δ金额| = 0
  对账结论 = 一致
  是否符合预期 = True

== 用例 B：对账不一致（期望检出差额） ==
  分区         DWD笔数 DWS笔数 Δ笔数 | DWD金额 DWS金额 Δ金额 | 一致
  2026-03-01        3      3     0 |     500     500      0 | True
  2026-03-02        3      2     1 |     700     480    220 | False
  合计 |Δ笔数| = 1，合计 |Δ金额| = 220
  对账结论 = 不一致
  是否符合预期 = True

判据 1（一致的跨层对账：笔数与金额差额均为 0）: True
判据 2（漏数据的 DWS 被对账检出：金额差额 != 0）: True
判据 3（差额可被定位到具体分区：03-02 少 1 笔、少 220 元）: True
